content.value: An uncrowned straight bevel pinion has 30 teeth, a diametral pitch of $^ { 6 , }$ and a transmission accuracy number of 6. The driven gear has 60 teeth. Both are made of grade 80-55-06 ductile iron. The shaft angle is 90°. The face width is 1.25 inch, the pinion speed is 900 rev/min, and the normal pressure angle is $2 0 ^ { \circ }$ The pinion is mounted outboard of its bearings; the bearings of the gear straddle it. What is the power rating based on AGMA bending strength? Assume life goal is $1 0 ^ { 9 }$ rev at a reliability of 0.99 and apply a factor of safety of 2.
